result.description: AI meeting assistant that records, transcribes, summarizes meetings and extracts action items.
result.auth_detail: REST Public API: static Bearer API key generated in dashboard (Integrations > Developer; max 2 keys/user). MCP server (mcp.otter.ai/mcp): OAuth 2.1 with browser consent and dynamic client registration; no OAuth on REST API.
result.access_detail: REST Public API reportedly Enterprise-workspace only (sources: Scalekit, apis.io; official docs not fetchable - help.otter.ai 403, otter.ai/api/docs JS-rendered). Hosted MCP server reportedly available on all plans incl. free Basic via OAuth, but only exposes 3 read-only tools. Official plan gating unconfirmed.
result.api_notes: Public REST API (api.otter.ai/v1 per third parties): conversations/transcripts, channels, members, audio download links, webhooks; ~10 req/s limit. MCP is narrow: search, fetch, get_user_info.
result.blocker: Full REST API appears Enterprise-only with static user-generated keys (no OAuth); OAuth route is the official MCP server with only 3 read-only tools. Official docs could not be directly verified.

evidence.quote: Anthropic's Claude connector page lists three tools: get_user_info, search, and fetch.
The API does not support OAuth at all; it uses a static Bearer key the user generates in the dashboard.
the MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 with a browser consent step
The Public API is reported as available to Enterprise workspaces only.
